info.description: Vietnamese stock market prediction system — ML algorithms (VWMA, EMA, LSTM, ARIMA-GARCH, Ensemble) for VN30 stocks, gold, NASDAQ, crypto, and S&P 500.
info.title: Go Stock Prediction API

get.description: Returns per-algorithm details including status (trained/untrained), configuration, accuracy, training time, total predictions, and success rate. Sourced from the algorithm registry and latest training logs.
Returns a list of past training sessions grouped by session ID, with per-algorithm results and overall accuracy. Optional filters: limit (1-50, default 10) and level (error|info).

parameters.description: Number of sessions to return (1-50, default 10)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Filter by log level: error or info
parameters.name: level

get.description: Returns aggregate training performance statistics including average training time, data quality score, success rate, total sessions, total predictions, and current process memory usage.
Returns whether training is in progress, the last trained time, next scheduled training, current phase, and progress percentage. Calls the prediction gRPC service internally.
Returns detailed information about a specific training session identified by numeric log ID or session UUID. Includes per-algorithm results aggregated from all logs belonging to that session.

parameters.description: Training log ID (numeric) or session UUID
parameters.name: id

post.description: Runs mysqldump, compresses the output with gzip, and saves it to the backup directory. Keeps only the 10 most recent backups. Requires admin role.
Starts a cryptocurrency (BTC/ETH) price crawl in the background via the prediction service. Returns 202 immediately.
Runs a prediction for all registered cryptocurrency instruments (BTC, ETH) in the background via the prediction service. Returns 202 immediately.
Crawls current gold prices (SJC BTMC and XAU/USD) synchronously via the prediction service.
Starts a walk-forward backtest over all gold instruments (XAU/spot, BTMC/sjc, BTMC/nhan_tron) in the background. Returns 202 immediately. Returns 409 if a backtest is already running.
Starts a historical XAU/USD gold price import in the background via the prediction service. Returns 202 immediately.
Runs a prediction for all gold instruments (XAU/spot, BTMC/sjc, BTMC/nhan_tron) in the background via the prediction service.

Starts a walk-forward backtest in the background via the prediction service. Accepts optional query params: train_window (default 30), step_size (default 6), and market (one of "", "VN30", "GOLD", "NASDAQ100", "CRYPTO", "SP500", "ALL"). Returns 409 if a backtest is already running.

parameters.description: Minimum data points before first prediction (default 30)
parameters.name: train_window

parameters.description: Fold size — data points between retraining (default 6)
parameters.name: step_size

parameters.description: Target market key: VN30, GOLD, NASDAQ100, CRYPTO, SP500, ALL (default: all)
parameters.name: market

post.description: Starts a NASDAQ100 price crawl in the background via the prediction service. Returns 202 immediately.
Runs a prediction for all NASDAQ100 instruments in the background via the prediction service. Returns 202 immediately.
Runs prediction reconciliation immediately, filling in actual_price, accuracy, and status for past predictions. Runs synchronously with a 10-minute timeout.
Closes stale live sessions and creates fresh running sessions for all active bots. Use when bots stop trading after the first day.
Sends a gRPC request to run backtest simulation for a specific bot or all bots. Accepts optional JSON body with bot_id, start_date, end_date.
Sends a gRPC request to advance all live simulation bots by one step using the latest available predictions.
Starts S&P 500 price crawler in the background via the prediction service.
Runs prediction for all S&P 500 symbols in the background via the prediction service.
Starts training for all algorithms or a specific algorithm. Returns 409 if training is already in progress. The algorithm field is optional; if omitted, all algorithms are trained.

get.description: Returns all registered users; requires admin role

post.description: Creates a new user account; requires admin role. Role defaults to "user" if an invalid value is supplied

delete.description: Deletes a user by ID; requires admin role. An admin cannot delete their own account

get.description: Returns full system health including database, config, and runtime metrics
Returns 200 READY when the database is reachable, 503 NOT READY otherwise
Lightweight liveness probe — returns 200 OK when the process is running
